The main takeaway from our work is that
there are many ways in which funding organizations can support health research, and that there is no one best way to do so.

the largest funders of health and health research are not necessarily the most transparent about their funding patterns and funding decisions, and that there is a need to increase transparency and standardization of reporting of health and health-related research funding.
there are many different ways to fund health research, and there is no one-size-fits-all model.
